title: Music Catalog Value Calculator: Build a Sale Scenario — SPACE
description: Calculate a hypothetical catalog sale from monthly net income, your assumed multiple and the share sold. Request a free individual catalog review.
headings: Your catalog is worth more than monthly royalties.
Gross revenue, net income and the rights sold
paragraphs: Free tool
Explore a hypothetical sale using your monthly net income and an assumed multiple you choose. This is not a market valuation or a SPACE offer.
Scenario inputs (USD)
Choose your own positive assumption. No market multiple is supplied. A multiple is not a number of years to multiply again, nor the legal term of a sale.
Use 0-100% of the rights represented by your net income. Do not subtract the sold share from the income first; the formula applies it once.
Enter valid income, a positive assumed multiple and a share from 0-100% to see a scenario. Zero income is allowed.
Not a market value, guaranteed price or SPACE offer. This arithmetic does not price risk, taxes, fees, recoupment or transfer conditions.
Free evaluation. No obligation.
Monthly net income x 12 x assumed multiple x share sold. There is no extra years multiplier and no predicted price range.

Gross revenue is before relevant deductions. Distributor receipts may already exclude some fees. Net income here means the income attributable to the defined rights after applicable distributor fees, third-party royalty payouts and operating costs. Avoid deducting an expense twice, and use one currency and a representative period.

Sound recording rights and composition rights are distinct. Only include income attributable to rights you own and can transfer. Selling part of your share is not the same as selling that percentage of the entire catalog. Outstanding advances, co-owner permissions and existing agreements need a separate review.
Read the music catalog valuation guide for the factors beyond this calculation.

An individual review considers documented income, the rights you can transfer, contracts and the risks attached to future earnings. This tool only calculates the assumptions you enter. It does not supply a market multiple or a SPACE offer.

It is the percentage of the defined rights and income represented by your inputs that you would sell, not automatically a percentage of every right in every recording and composition. A partial sale may be possible, subject to ownership and agreement.

SPACE typically provides an initial offer within 5-7 business days after receiving the relevant information, if the catalog is a fit. Payment is by bank transfer after the agreement is complete and transfer conditions are satisfied. The calculator does not promise a payment date.
You can propose specific tracks, albums or a share of defined rights for review. The transferable scope, retained rights and any consent requirements must be confirmed before a sale.

If your catalog is a fit, an initial offer typically follows within 5-7 business days after we receive the relevant information. Payment follows the completed agreement and satisfied transfer conditions.
We review revenue-generating music catalogs directly, across genres.
